ED Corner – July 2026

Happy July, everyone!

It’s been an amazing summer so far of cookouts, nights spent with friends, and of course, refreshing Happy Hours to help us cool down. In our childhoods, it was around this time of year that many of us started looking towards the dreaded return to the classroom – but here at our campus, the middle of July means that the party is just getting started.

As we head deeper into the season, there’s still plenty to look forward to around campus. From live entertainment and themed events to afternoons spent outside enjoying the sunshine, summer always has a way of bringing people together. It’s been wonderful seeing everyone catching up with neighbors, welcoming visiting family members, and making the most of these longer days. We hope you’ll continue joining us for all the fun, laughter, and little moments that make this time of year so special.

Have a great month!

Yours in Service,

Olivia Curavo LNHA

Executive Director

articles.body:
Submit an article from your Legacy Leader or Legacy Neighborhood Director (should also include photos to accompany article):

There’s nothing quite like enjoying a beautiful day outdoors, and our recent Picnic in the Park was the perfect opportunity to do just that! Residents gathered together to share a delicious meal, soak up the sunshine, and enjoy each other’s company in a relaxed setting. Filled with laughter, conversation, and plenty of smiles, the afternoon provided a wonderful chance to create meaningful memories and celebrate the simple joys of community. Moments like these remind us that some of life’s best memories are made with good food, fresh air, and great friends.
articles.title: Legacy News

articles.body: We are proud to announce that Jeremiah Bates is our new DFS at GRV. He enjoys what he does, puts the residents first and his upbeat personality is contagious!
articles.title: We are proud to announce that Jeremiah Bates is our new DFS at GRV

articles.body: Our resident Marie was unable to physically attend her class reunion states away but was able to attend virtually. We were honored to make her experience the very best! Members of our dietary staff Jerimiah and Jenny were given recipes from the small hometown restaurant that was catering for the reunion and made sure Marie had the exact food here in Ohio. We decorated the room in the school colors and mascot along with pictures from her yearbook as well as her senior picture. We were honored to be a part of her special day and to make her feel included in every detail.
articles.title: Our resident Marie was unable to physically attend her class reunion states away but was able to attend virtually

articles.body: We had amazing time jumping back into the past! Tie dye and groovy vibes were the theme! The staff and resident enjoyed making their own tie dye t-shirts and wearing them to our blast from the past happy hour.
